_documentation.purpose: Extras that can be added to a bouquet: bears (stuffed toys) and chocolates.
conventions: Top level is an object with two keys: `_documentation` (this block, ignored by the app) and `items` (the array of records the app reads).
Prices are in Philippine pesos (PHP), stored as plain numbers with no currency symbol.
`null` means the value is not known yet. It never means zero. Check for null before doing math on a value.
Enumerated values (type, origin, occasion, mood, etc.) are lowercase, with hyphens instead of spaces where noted.
`id` values are unique and stable. Gaps in the numbering are fine, and ids should not be reused or renumbered.
`image` paths are served from the site root, so `/images/flowers/x.png` means the file `public/images/flowers/x.png`. The image files themselves have not been added yet.

fields.name: string. Display name.
fields.size: string or null. Bear height (`1-2 ft`, `3 ft`, `5 ft`). Null for chocolates.
fields.brand: string or null. Chocolate brand. Null for stuffed toys.
fields.price: number or null. Bear prices are filled in. Chocolate prices are not known yet.
fields.description: string. Free text, may be empty.
fields.active: boolean. `false` hides the item from the app (unfinished entries or placeholders). Inactive items stay in the file.
